result.question: Why is Christian Watson scoring so many fantasy points this season?
result.answer: Christian Watson's scoring is driven by touchdown efficiency, with 6 TDs accounting for 30.3% of his 118.8 total PPR points, and 7 of 35 red-zone targets (20%) converting into points. While his opportunity declined in weeks 4-6—average snap share fell from 82% to 78.7% and target share dropped from 25.8% to 18.6%, pushing PPR per game from 23.1 to 16.5—his red-zone target share and improved yards per target (rising from 10.6 to 13.9) sustain fantasy value despite the downward trend. Verdict: start Christian Watson.

claims.text: Christian Watson: GB, WR, roster status ACT (week 7).

evidence.sql: SELECT r.gsis_id, r.full_name, r.team, r.position, r.status, r.week FROM NFLVERSE.rosters r JOIN (SELECT gsis_id, MAX(week) AS week FROM NFLVERSE.rosters WHERE season = 2026 AND LOWER(full_name) IN ('christian watson', 'why is', 'is christian', 'watson scoring', 'scoring so', 'so many', 'many fantasy', 'fantasy points', 'points this', 'this season', 'why is christian', 'is christian watson', 'christian watson scoring', 'watson scoring so', 'scoring so many', 'so many fantasy', 'many fantasy points', 'fantasy points this', 'points this season') GROUP BY gsis_id) latest ON r.gsis_id = latest.gsis_id AND r.week = latest.week WHERE r.season = 2026 AND r.position IN ('QB', 'RB', 'WR', 'TE') ORDER BY r.full_name

claims.text: Latest injury report: week 7, no game status; Limited Participation in Practice.

evidence.sql: SELECT week, report_status, report_primary_injury, practice_status FROM NFLVERSE.injuries WHERE season = 2026 AND gsis_id = '00-0038124' ORDER BY week

claims.text: Christian Watson's 6 touchdowns account for 30.3% of his 118.8 total PPR points, and 7 of 35 red-zone targets (20%) further boost his scoring efficiency.

evidence.sql: SELECT ps.week, ps.receiving_tds, ps.rushing_tds, 6 * (ps.receiving_tds + ps.rushing_tds) AS td_points, ROUND(ps.fantasy_points_ppr, 1) AS ppr_points, COALESCE(rz.rz_targets, 0) AS rz_targets, COALESCE(rz.team_rz_targets, 0) AS team_rz_targets, COALESCE(rz.rz_carries, 0) AS rz_carries FROM NFLVERSE.player_stats ps LEFT JOIN (SELECT game_id, posteam, SUM(CASE WHEN receiver_player_id = '00-0038124' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rz_targets, SUM(CASE WHEN receiver_player_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS team_rz_targets, SUM(CASE WHEN rusher_player_id = '00-0038124' AND rush = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rz_carries FROM NFLVERSE.pbp WHERE season = 2026 AND yardline_100 <= 20 AND play_type IN ('pass', 'run') GROUP BY game_id, posteam) rz ON rz.game_id = ps.game_id AND rz.posteam = ps.team WHERE ps.season = 2026 AND ps.player_id = '00-0038124' ORDER BY ps.week

claims.text: Christian Watson's 19.8 PPR points per game this season stem from a strong opportunity factor, with 80.3% average snap share and 22.2% average target share over 6 games, but his scoring declined in weeks 4-6 as snap share dropped to 78.7% and target share fell to 18.6%.

evidence.sql: SELECT ps.week, ps.opponent_team, sc.offense_snaps, ROUND(100 * sc.offense_pct, 1) AS snap_pct, ps.targets, ROUND(100 * ps.target_share, 1) AS target_share_pct, ps.receptions, ps.carries, ROUND(ps.fantasy_points_ppr, 1) AS ppr_points FROM NFLVERSE.player_stats ps LEFT JOIN NFLVERSE.snap_counts sc ON sc.game_id = ps.game_id AND sc.player = ps.player_display_name AND sc.team = ps.team WHERE ps.season = 2026 AND ps.player_id = '00-0038124' ORDER BY ps.week

claims.text: Teammate absences in Weeks 3-6 increased Watson's target share and yards per target, contributing to his elevated scoring.

evidence.sql: SELECT week, full_name, position, report_status, report_primary_injury FROM NFLVERSE.injuries WHERE season = 2026 AND team = 'GB' AND gsis_id <> '00-0038124' AND position IN ('QB', 'RB', 'WR', 'TE') AND report_status IN ('Out', 'Doubtful') ORDER BY week, position, full_name LIMIT 50

claims.text: Watson's scoring is partly explained by a higher pass rate in losses (76.2%) compared to wins or ties (63.2%), with his best early-season pass rate of 72.3% in weeks 1-3 dropping to 62.8% in weeks 4-6.

evidence.sql: SELECT p.week, MAX(p.defteam) AS opponent, SUM(p.pass) AS pass_plays, SUM(p.rush) AS rush_plays, ROUND(100 * SUM(p.pass) / NULLIF(SUM(p.pass) + SUM(p.rush), 0), 1) AS pass_rate_pct, MAX(CASE WHEN s.home_team = 'GB' THEN s.home_score - s.away_score ELSE s.away_score - s.home_score END) AS final_margin FROM NFLVERSE.pbp p JOIN NFLVERSE.schedules s ON s.game_id = p.game_id WHERE p.season = 2026 AND p.posteam = 'GB' GROUP BY p.week ORDER BY p.week

claims.text: Christian Watson's 11.2 yards per target and 10 plays of 20+ yards indicate big-play ability, but his yards per target increased from 10.6 in weeks 1-3 to 13.9 in weeks 4-6, suggesting improved efficiency rather than sustained big-play volume as the primary driver of his scoring.

evidence.sql: SELECT ps.week, ps.targets, ps.receiving_yards, ROUND(ps.receiving_air_yards, 1) AS air_yards, ROUND(100 * ps.air_yards_share, 1) AS air_yards_share_pct, ROUND(ps.receiving_yards / NULLIF(ps.targets, 0), 1) AS yards_per_target, COALESCE(b.plays_20_plus, 0) AS plays_20_plus, b.longest_play FROM NFLVERSE.player_stats ps LEFT JOIN (SELECT game_id, SUM(CASE WHEN yards_gained >= 20 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS plays_20_plus, MAX(yards_gained) AS longest_play FROM NFLVERSE.pbp WHERE season = 2026 AND play_type IN ('pass', 'run') AND (receiver_player_id = '00-0038124' OR rusher_player_id = '00-0038124') GROUP BY game_id) b ON b.game_id = ps.game_id WHERE ps.season = 2026 AND ps.player_id = '00-0038124' ORDER BY ps.week

claims.text: Christian Watson averages 21.7 PPR points per game against non-top-10 defenses, which accounts for 4 of 6 games played this season.

evidence.sql: WITH allowed AS (SELECT opponent_team, week, SUM(fantasy_points_ppr) AS pts FROM NFLVERSE.player_stats WHERE season = 2026 AND position = 'WR' GROUP BY opponent_team, week), avg_allowed AS (SELECT opponent_team, ROUND(AVG(pts), 1) AS avg_ppr_allowed FROM allowed GROUP BY opponent_team), ranked AS (SELECT opponent_team, avg_ppr_allowed, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY avg_ppr_allowed DESC) AS allowed_rank FROM avg_allowed) SELECT ps.week, ps.opponent_team, ROUND(ps.fantasy_points_ppr, 1) AS ppr_points, r.avg_ppr_allowed AS opp_avg_ppr_allowed_to_wr, r.allowed_rank FROM NFLVERSE.player_stats ps LEFT JOIN ranked r ON r.opponent_team = ps.opponent_team WHERE ps.season = 2026 AND ps.player_id = '00-0038124' ORDER BY ps.week
